title: measuretwice dataset metadata (v0)
description: Metadata for one JSONL case dataset. Stored next to the case records. Declares population, sampling, label guidelines, and splits. The case records and this file together form the dataset.

revision.description: Dataset revision. Changed content needs a new revision and a new content hash.

kind.description: Development fixtures and synthetic challenge sets are not representative population samples. Qualification claims need representative samples.

intended_population.description: Population that the sampling procedure targets.

sampling_method.description: How the cases were selected. Active selection of hard cases is not a prevalence estimate.

label_guidelines.description: Written label guidelines, or an explicit reference to them.

languages.description: Language tags that occur in the cases.

record_count.description: Number of case records. Must match the record file.

content_hash.description: Hash of the canonical case-record content. Computed with the hashing contract.

purpose.description: Fitting splits tune candidates. Validation splits provide independent evidence.

groups.description: Groups assigned to this split. One group appears in one split only.

content_hash.description: Hash of the canonical records of this split.

splits.description: Grouped splits. Rust verifies that no group appears in two splits.
